description.en: Long CLP funding against long UF assets, so the two legs move in opposite directions.
description.es: Fondeo largo en CLP contra activos largos en UF: los dos tramos se mueven en sentido contrario.

statement.en: A positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss; only losses are aggregated across currencies.
statement.es: Un delta EVE o delta NII positivo es una perdida; solo las perdidas se agregan entre monedas.

notice.en: Synthetic bank calibrated to public aggregates; fixture values.
notice.es: Banco sintetico calibrado a agregados publicos; valores de ejemplo.

ur_currency.label: UR

definition.en: All CLP-indexed (UF) flows are treated as one currency, UR (RAN 21-13 Annex 1).
definition.es: Todos los flujos reajustables (UF) se tratan como una sola moneda, UR (RAN 21-13 Anexo 1).

ur_currency.uf_source: fixture value, not the BCCh UF

clp.source: fixture: BCCh BDE F022 sovereign yields (values are fixtures)
clp.attribution: Source: Banco Central de Chile (BDE), series F022.BCLP.TIS.AN05.NO.Z.D. The fitted zero curve is an adaptation by Contraste and is its sole responsibility (BCCh terms). Fixture, not a result.

ur.source: fixture: BCCh BDE F022 sovereign yields (values are fixtures)
ur.attribution: Source: Banco Central de Chile (BDE), series F022.BUF.TIS.AN02.UF.Z.D, F022.BUF.TIS.AN10.UF.Z.D. The fitted zero curve is an adaptation by Contraste and is its sole responsibility (BCCh terms). Fixture, not a result.

nmd_core_share.source: balance-weighted average of the used values of nmd_segments

nmd_core_maturity_years.source: balance-weighted average of the used values of nmd_segments

prepayment_cpr.source: fixture value; no item carries the prepayable-loan class

description.en: Constant balance sheet: maturing and repricing flows are replaced by identical new ones.
description.es: Balance constante: los flujos que vencen o reprecian se reemplazan por otros identicos.

rule.en: Post-shock rates are floored at -2 percent for UR and at 0 percent for CLP. The fixture also keeps a rate that is already below its floor at its pre-shock value, for both floors; whether Annex 1 applies that clause to the UR floor is UNVERIFIED.
rule.es: Las tasas post choque tienen piso de -2 por ciento para UR y 0 por ciento para CLP. El ejemplo tambien mantiene en su valor previo una tasa que ya esta bajo su piso, en ambos pisos; que el Anexo 1 aplique esa clausula al piso UR no esta verificado.

rule.en: When delta CLP and delta CLF have opposite signs, half of the CLP is offset against the CLF (or the reverse), floored at zero.
rule.es: Si los deltas CLP y CLF tienen signos opuestos, se compensa la mitad del CLP contra el CLF (o al reves), con piso en cero.

indexation_charge.formula: charge = 0.025 x |PN_UR|, PN_UR = net UF position x UF value

note.en: The standardised indexation (reajustabilidad) charge, an implied 2.5 percent inflation surprise.
note.es: El cargo estandar por reajustabilidad, equivalente a una sorpresa de inflacion de 2,5 por ciento.

label.en: Delta NII with the indexation charge
label.es: Delta NII con el cargo por reajustabilidad
